recognize_zh: 淋巴結內一團界線清楚的大型組織球聚集，細胞質豐富、淡粉紅至泡沫狀，部分組織球細胞質內含完整小淋巴球（emperipolesis），外圍被一圈小淋巴球包圍，型態類似 Rosai-Dorfman 型組織球變化。
features: Well-circumscribed nodular aggregate of large histiocytes rimmed by a cuff of small lymphocytes
Histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli
Occasional histiocytes containing intact small lymphocytes within the cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells within and around the aggregate
Surrounding interfollicular tissue with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and prominent small vessels
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a well-circumscribed aggregate of large histiocytes with abundant pale, eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei, surrounded by a rim of small lymphocytes. Occasional histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm (emperipolesis). The surrounding parenchyma contains small lymphocytes, plasma cells and prominent vessels. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman-type histiocytic change, here as a focal finding in a lymph node from a patient with systemic mastocytosis; S100 and CD1a immunostains help confirm.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, kidney-shaped nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a+/langerin+, whereas Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes have round nuclei with emperipolesis and are S100+/CD1a-.
Reactive sinus histiocytes lack emperipolesis and are S100-negative.
Mast cells are spindled to oval with granular cytoplasm and tryptase/CD117+, whereas these large histiocytes engulf lymphocytes and are S100+.
Epithelioid granulomas have elongated nuclei, multinucleated giant cells and sometimes necrosis, without emperipolesis.
